entry.label: Information
entry.description: Information is not raw stuff that flows unchanged through channels. A signal becomes information only within some receiving organisation, code, concern or capacity to respond.
entry.canonical_definition: A difference selected and taken up within an organised context so that it can alter expectation, state or action; its mathematical measure is distinct from meaning and use.

profile.title: Information
profile.canonical_definition: A difference selected and taken up within an organised context so that it can alter expectation, state or action; its mathematical measure is distinct from meaning and use.
profile.summary: Information is not raw stuff that flows unchanged through channels. A signal becomes information only within some receiving organisation, code, concern or capacity to respond. Bateson's formulation selects differences through their effects within a circuit. It does not turn the mathematical quantity of information into a measure of meaning.
profile.why_it_matters: Public and organisational systems routinely confuse data volume with understanding. The key questions are what differences are sensed, how they are coded, who can interpret them and what action they enable. Ask what changed for the recipient, not merely what was transmitted.
key_distinctions: difference available versus difference taken up
practice_connections: check whether the receiver has a code and response repertoire
reduce reporting that cannot affect action
Trace a report through the action it enables, blocks, or fails to change.
common_misreadings: Sending a message proves it informed someone.
open_checks: Keep the several meanings of information explicit.
profile.editorial_note: Primary passages checked for this bounded research pass. Exposition and editorial comparisons remain distinct; named editorial acceptance is not implied by publication.
